title: I had a peculiar mall world experience last night
content: So in my dream last night (or this morning), I remembered that in my mallworld dream, I was talking to someone in the dream about Mallworld itself, talking to them about how familiar I am with this place, and telling them all about the little details of the place. I was specifically telling them about the beautiful river and hill area that I have been visiting in my dreams for the last decade. This isn’t the first time this has happened to me. Often in my mallworld dreams I look around at the place and know where I am from past dreams. I am not entirely sure if this is lucid. I’ve never been able to fully lucid dream. I have had precognitive dreams though, and I often recognise dream settings from past dreams, and in this case , able to tell other people who are in the dream about the mallworld. It’s so peculiar. For some context, I’ve been having mallworld dreams for at least a decade now, possibly longer. I am 30 (f). My mallworld most frequently consists of a typical mall, an airport, a hotel (specifically the hotel lobby), a futuristic train station with underground platforms, specific city streets that are modern, some dilapidated building sites on some streets, specific housing estates, a rich and prosperous area, a beautiful river, hills, and strangely a place I know as being a boardwalk area … it’s like near a pier on the beach , it’s made of rickety old wood , has some shops and a lot of flimsy and dangerous bridges.
